test_sampling_repeat: test the sampling.repeat function to repeat an executable multiple times with distinct sampling keys
test_sampling_repeat_and_execute: test the sampling.repeat_and_execute function to repeat and execute an executable in parallel
test_sampling_nested_repeat: test the sampling.repeat_and_execute function with nested static and dynamic executable creation
test_sampling_update_result: test the sampling.repeat_and_execute function with a custom update_result_fn to modify results
test_sampling_round_robin: test the sampling.RoundRobin sampler to alternate between multiple Repeated samplers
